primary_endpoint.name: Paired Downside Shortfall Reduction on Causal Defensive Sessions

return_convention.cost_model: Simulated commissions ($0 on modern US equity brokers) + bid-ask half-spread model (5 bps on leveraged ETFs, 2 bps on defensive ETFs) + 50% cash yield at current risk-free rate

primary_endpoint.exclusions_policy: Exchange holidays, emergency market halts, incomplete vendor bar feeds, and ticker delisting days are excluded from evaluation.
primary_endpoint.incident_handling: Sessions occurring during an active INCIDENT_LOCK are quarantined into a separate incident ledger and excluded from primary causal inference.

hypothesis_1_directional.test_type: One-sided test of directional non-negative downside reduction

hypothesis_2_economic_hurdle.test_type: One-sided test of economically meaningful downside alpha
hypothesis_2_economic_hurdle.promotion_gate: MANDATORY. Strategy certification requires rejecting H02 at alpha = 0.05.

primary_non_parametric_test.name: Politis & Romano (1994) Stationary Block Bootstrap
primary_non_parametric_test.block_length_parameter: Geometric distribution with mean b = \lceil N_{def}^{1/3} \rceil

discrepancy_resolution_rule.rule: CONSERVATIVE_DISJUNCTION. Promotion requires BOTH p_{HAC} < 0.05 AND p_{boot} < 0.05. If HAC rejects but Bootstrap fails (or vice versa), the more conservative non-rejection verdict governs (verdict: INCONCLUSIVE / FAIL TO REJECT H02).

sensitivity_analyses_preregistration.hurdle_sensitivity: Evaluate delta in [0 bps, 5 bps, 10 bps, 15 bps]
sensitivity_analyses_preregistration.multiplicity_control: Hierarchical testing: Secondary CAGR non-inferiority is tested if and only if Primary Hurdle H02 is rejected at alpha = 0.05.
sensitivity_analyses_preregistration.data_restatement_policy: If provider restates historical bars after event freeze, original recorded EOD bars govern the primary verdict. Restated bars are analyzed solely in an audit sensitivity annex.

owner_governance_status.legal_notice: Neither the 10-bps hurdle nor the Newey-West lag formula may be approved by autonomous agents. Human owner signature is required.
